L2(Omega)^2 denotes the vector-valued space, not the squared norm.

Theorem 3 allows observation windows with T0=0, as well as 0<T0<T and a single time T0=T>0. Page 4: Omega=[0,2pi]^2 is the flat torus with periodic functions. C-infinity and ordinary Sobolev H^m for integer m are defined; vector spaces X^2 may be abbreviated as X. H consists of L2 divergence-free zero-mean fields; V is the corresponding H1 space. V uses the gradient inner product, not the full inhomogeneous H1 norm.
